spec.experiment: SG33 hierarchical residual SA refinement and coarse Markov semantic reachability
spec.ca: frozen A3: SD1.5, selected eleven CA modules, calls 0-30, all heads, class-word W, no restored 32x32 CA
spec.sa: SG25 modules 16/32/64, matched calls 10-20 inclusive, eight heads; sequential call-wise head-mean hierarchy
spec.h0: SG31 S2 sequential 16 to 32 to 64 hierarchy control
spec.residuals: per-call minmax stage normalization; H1 equal, H2 .2/.3/.5, H3 1/9 5/9 3/9, H4 max(r64,.5r32,.25r16)
spec.selection: five frozen VOC folds; raw/R2 separately; forced OOF, pairwise wins and registered multi-candidate selector; VOC full threshold frozen to COCO
spec.storage: resumable counts, compact per-image Markov/stage diagnostics and small representative visual sheets only; no generated images, dense maps, QK or affinity cache
